evidence_level: direct inspection of hash-checked sparse and half-second contact sheets from cached media

visible_observations.observation: Centered Japanese lyric lettering has pale fill and bright cyan/pink outline above a purple perspective grid and neon icons.

Different panels use curved border microtype, circular text around a ball motif, and pixel-like dialogue boxes with character art. These are designed elements visible in the frame, not inferred editor controls.

A bold yellow word is emphasized within a pink-outlined lyric line over a lightning bolt, two dark character silhouettes, green foreground shapes and a repeated small-text border. Yellow electric flashes appear at 89–90 s; the main layout remains similar through 98 s in the sampled frames.
The layout cuts through a static/noise field to a dark panel with angular hot-pink lettering; more lettering is visible by 100.5–101 s.

sources.typography: Multiple visibly different treatments: outlined rounded Japanese lettering, bold yellow emphasis, angular hot-pink display lettering, tiny repeated border type. Exact font families unknown.
sources.motion_evidence: Half-second frames support electric flashing, a blurred transition frame at 91.5 s, a noisy cut near 98.5 s, and staged text appearance near 100 s. Exact curves and full-shot timing unknown.
sources.observed_neighbor_context: In the sampled window the emphasized line persists above dark figures and a lightning motif from 89–98 s, then a noisy cut separates the hot-pink lettering at 99.5–101 s.

conditional_applicability.possible_emotion_or_meaning: A charged, playful, teasing or urgent lyric beat could use a single high-contrast word and electric accent; this is a design hypothesis, not a reading of the source song.
conditional_applicability.image_relationship: Place the stressed word above the silhouetted figures and align electric accents with the lightning shape without obscuring the figures' faces or the lyric line.
conditional_applicability.use_when: A short, emphasized lyric can be read clearly against a busy illustrated scene and the adjacent shot can support a strong cut.
conditional_applicability.avoid_when: A quiet or intimate phrase needs visual stillness, or the border microtype and flashes would compete with essential words.
conditional_applicability.alternative: Keep one outlined line stable over the silhouettes with a restrained color change instead of a full electric/noise transition.

sources.source_kind: public Niconico upload; title claims Scratch text-PV

visible_observations.observation: Inside a window-like rectangular composition on a square grid, text appears in a comic burst, small centered line, repeated glyph array and speech bubbles.
The central region changes from large burst lettering to a dark circular cut while the surrounding top credit strip and bottom caption stay present.
Very large overlapping Japanese characters in black, red and blue-green are cropped at the edges and intercut with a clear grid.
Separated black characters, a narrow vertical pile of repeated glyphs, and further oversized colored characters follow in the sampled short window.

sources.typography: Heavy black Japanese glyphs alternate with red/blue-green enlarged glyphs, small scattered text, repeated stamps and comic balloons. Exact fonts unknown.
sources.motion_evidence: At half-second samples the framed composition changes rapidly and sometimes clears between lettering states; exact paths, interpolation and whether the frame mimics software UI by design are unknown.
sources.observed_neighbor_context: A burst panel at 27–28 s gives way to a dark circular cut at 28.5 s; large overlapping characters and then scattered/stacked glyphs occupy the same gridded central region through 38 s.

conditional_applicability.possible_emotion_or_meaning: Comic bursts, oversized overlaps and repeated glyphs could suit a rapid, insistent or argumentative phrase; this is a conditional design use, not a source emotion finding.
conditional_applicability.image_relationship: The grid can anchor chaotic lettering while the central word remains legible; top credits and bottom captions should not be copied as lyric design without resolving their role.
conditional_applicability.use_when: A brief repeated word or call-and-response can tolerate quick changes between a burst, clear grid and repeated glyph cluster.
conditional_applicability.avoid_when: Long lines, subtle imagery or accessibility demands require sustained reading time; edge-cropped glyphs can hide essential text.
conditional_applicability.alternative: Hold the main phrase in one high-contrast grid cell and reserve a single comic burst for the stressed syllable.

sources.excluded_from_style_claim: Persistent top credit strip and bottom caption may be video framing rather than the creative PV region.

sources.source_kind: public Niconico upload; title claims Alight Motion/Blurrr text-PV

visible_observations.observation: White and cyan fields, thin line/circle accents and a pale outlined title give way to oversized rounded cyan Japanese glyphs, tilted and cropped by the frame.
Large characters occupy different angles and edges across successive half-second samples, followed by lighter scattered glyphs inside a circular outline.
Small cyan headings and a dotted panel gain additional words and ring graphics, then a large cyan disc/edge crop appears. An Alight Motion watermark is visibly present at the bottom.

sources.typography: Rounded cyan filled glyphs, pale outlined letters, occasional small headings and thin geometric marks; exact font identities unknown.
sources.motion_evidence: Half-second states show changing scale, angle, cropping and additions. Specific transforms/curves are not established by these samples.
sources.observed_neighbor_context: Oversized tilted glyphs and line accents at 4–7 s move into scattered and ringed text at 8–9.5 s, then small headings and circular graphics accumulate at 10–12 s.

conditional_applicability.possible_emotion_or_meaning: An airy, playful or brisk technical feeling could use this white/cyan field and moving glyph focus; this is a design hypothesis, not a verified meaning of the source audio.
conditional_applicability.image_relationship: The open field supports large isolated characters and circular accents; a competing portrait or detailed background would require a protected clear region.
conditional_applicability.use_when: Short words can enter with generous whitespace and a deliberate color/scale hierarchy.
conditional_applicability.avoid_when: Pale outlines on white or severely cropped glyphs would lower lyric readability, especially on small screens.
conditional_applicability.alternative: Use darker cyan filled text with a steadier position and one ring accent while keeping the white field.
